NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby order and decree as follows:
Section 1. The effectivity of P.D. No. 779 imposing a schedular income tax on capital gains arising from
stock transactions is hereby suspended indefinitely.
Section 2. Effectivity This Decree shall take effect retroactively from January 1, 1976.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
